information_rule: Same dataset, group split, supervision, observable events and decision deadline within each comparison. No pooled leaderboard across incompatible targets.

models.name: Logistic regression
models.technique: Linear decision on fixed normalized log features

models.name: Histogram gradient boosting
models.technique: 100 sequential boosted trees, no internal validation split

models.name: Multilabel logistic regression
models.technique: One binary classifier per source-defined step, overlapping labels preserved

models.name: Robustness context and missing-record controls
models.technique: Four fixed logistic arms: generic event, semantic event, prior entity context, and sample-weighted random-record-dropout training
models.limits: Positive random-loss result on Casino; structured command-record loss can worsen two targets; no consistent AIT augmentation benefit

models.name: Train-only lexical allowlist / novelty
models.technique: Previously unseen observable operations or names

models.name: Isolation forest
models.gate: Qualified benign fit timelines; compare with other benign-only models

models.name: TCN or small temporal Transformer
models.gate: Validated causal windows and same-history tabular controls

models.name: GraphSAGE / GAT
models.gate: Source-grounded graph adapter; no arbitrary graph construction from labels

models.name: Temporal graph network
models.technique: Entity state updated by events available at decision time
models.gate: Verified arrival order and future-invariance tests

models.name: Qwen classifier
models.technique: Fixed evidence-to-decision prompt or separately registered tuning
models.gate: Pinned model revision, same evidence/context budget, qualified output behavior, measured latency; unknown pretraining benchmark exposure

models.name: Structured-record-loss training and observed-record specialists
models.technique: Six fixed arms; record-type and mixed augmentation; four visible-current-record specialists with unique-target support and fallback
models.limits: All four primary development targets fail complete success criteria; external CAM task is a limited manifestation-window proxy; no novel method established
